analyzer.name: cbm
analyzer.description: Tree-sitter-based code knowledge graph server by DeusData

project_identification.description: DR CLI passes the project root as an absolute path via findProjectRoot(). The analyzer uses this path to establish a stable project identity for consistent indexing and caching across sessions.

analyzer.notes: Uses absolute path indexing for project identification. Ensures consistent graph generation and caching across multiple analysis runs within the same project.

Route.description: HTTP route maps to API operation with high confidence

Function.description: Function maps to application function; may be promoted to service via heuristics

Method.description: Class method maps to application function; may be promoted to service via heuristics

Module.description: Module (file/namespace) maps to application component with low confidence

Interface.description: In-code interface maps to an application data object. Tier-0 rules in extraction-heuristics.json take precedence: a Spring Data repository interface is data-store.accesspattern, an interface in generated client code or a component's props interface is not an element, and any other interface is narrowed to data object, application interface, application event or data-model object schema for the classifier to decide.

Type.description: Type alias or object type follows the Interface rules: an application data object unless generated or a component's props type.

Enum.description: Enumeration of values held in code follows the Interface rules: an application data object.

Struct.description: Plain struct maps to an application data object; one with receiver methods or an impl block behaves like a class (application component), which the classifier decides.

Trait.description: Behavioural contract implemented by types follows the Interface rules.

HANDLES.description: A function or method handles an HTTP route: the API operation for that route realizes the application function
HANDLES.implementation_note: CBM writes the edge handler → Route; the DR relationship runs from the operation to the function it realizes (api.operation.realizes.application.applicationfunction), so the direction is inverted. HANDLES names routes by path while Route nodes are named __route__METHOD__/path.

HTTP_CALLS.description: Outbound HTTP call from code to an API route
HTTP_CALLS.implementation_note: Blocked on a catalog addition: no relationship from an application type to api.operation expresses a consumer calling an operation (the catalog has api.operation references application.applicationservice and api.operation references api.operation only). Traversal only until the catalog gains one; see addition 7 in docs/analyzers/CBM_MAPPING_INVENTORY.md.

DEFINES_METHOD.description: A class defines a method: the application component is assigned the application function
DEFINES_METHOD.implementation_note: Map only when both ends survive Tier-1 classification as these types; most methods are not elements on their own.

IMPORTS.description: Module or file import dependency: one application component uses another
IMPORTS.implementation_note: Map only between modules both classified as application components; imports of external packages, and of anything else, stay traversal input (datastore detection reads them).

DEFINES.implementation_note: Provenance: supplies source_reference.file for every element mapped from a symbol. Not a relationship between elements.

EXTENDS.implementation_note: Present in the CBM 0.10.2 binary only, not in its documented vocabulary or any observed graph; kept for forward compatibility. INHERITS is the edge CBM emits for class extension.

high.description: High confidence: mapping is reliable and well-supported by evidence

medium.description: Medium confidence: mapping is reasonably supported but may have ambiguity

low.description: Low confidence: mapping is tentative and may require manual verification

heuristics.name: min_fan_in
heuristics.description: Function/method with high fan-in (many callers) may be a service
heuristics.rule: If a function/method is called by 5+ other functions/methods, it exhibits service-like behavior and is eligible for promotion to applicationservice

heuristics.name: directory_match
heuristics.description: Element location in canonical service directories indicates service-level component
heuristics.rule: If element resides in directory matching service-level patterns, promote eligible functions to applicationservice

heuristics.name: naming_patterns
heuristics.description: Naming conventions indicate service-level components
heuristics.rule: If function/class name ends with service-indicating suffix (Service, Manager, Repository, etc.), promote eligible functions to applicationservice

heuristics.name: class_is_service
heuristics.description: Class structure and interface patterns indicate service behavior
heuristics.rule: If class implements interfaces, uses dependency injection, or has 3+ public methods, it may represent a service abstraction

heuristics.name: service_class_naming
heuristics.description: Class names following service patterns within classes indicate service methods
heuristics.rule: If method within service-named class uses CRUD or action-oriented prefix, it exhibits service operation behavior

heuristics.name: is_entry_point
heuristics.description: Functions that serve as entry points (main, handler, endpoint) indicate service potential
heuristics.rule: If function name or type suggests it serves as entry point (handler, endpoint, listener), it may represent service operation

heuristics.name: handles_route
heuristics.description: Functions that handle HTTP routes map directly to API operations
heuristics.rule: Function/method decorated with @Route, @Handler, or similar HTTP decorator maps to api.operation with high confidence

heuristics.name: datastore_detection
heuristics.description: Patterns and conventions that identify datastore-related elements (tables, schemas, migrations)
heuristics.rule: If element resides in datastore-related directories or files, or follows datastore naming conventions, identify it as a data-store collection or field, or a data-model object schema or schema property

heuristics.name: tier0_generated_code
heuristics.description: Symbols in generated client code are not elements
heuristics.rule: An interface, type, enum or function in a generated file (*.gen.ts, client/core/) is generator output, not a modelled element; the published API it was generated from is

heuristics.name: tier0_component_props
heuristics.description: A component's props type belongs to the component
heuristics.rule: An interface or type named ...Props in a .tsx or .jsx file declares a UI component's inputs and is part of that component, not an element of its own

heuristics.name: tier0_spring_data_repository
heuristics.description: Repository interfaces are data-store access patterns
heuristics.rule: An interface or class extending a Spring Data style repository (JpaRepository, CrudRepository, Repository) declares how the store is queried

heuristics.name: tier0_repository_query
heuristics.description: Query annotations mark data-store access patterns
heuristics.rule: A method annotated @Query or @Modifying is a declared store query

heuristics.name: tier0_route_handler
heuristics.description: Route-mapping decorators mark API operations
heuristics.rule: A method or function decorated with a route mapping (@GetMapping, @PostMapping, @RequestMapping, router.get, app.post, ...) is the implementation of an API operation

heuristics.name: tier0_controller
heuristics.description: Controller annotations mark application interfaces
heuristics.rule: A class annotated @Controller or @RestController is the application interface its routes are served through

heuristics.name: tier0_persistent_entity
heuristics.description: Persistence annotations mark data-model object schemas
heuristics.rule: A class annotated @Entity, @Table, @MappedSuperclass, @Embeddable or @Document defines the shape of persisted data

heuristics.name: tier0_sqlmodel_table
heuristics.description: SQLModel table classes are data-store collections
heuristics.rule: A SQLModel class declared with table=True is a database table

heuristics.name: tier0_sqlmodel_schema
heuristics.description: SQLModel classes without a table are object schemas
heuristics.rule: A class deriving directly from SQLModel without table=True defines a data shape (request, response or base schema)

heuristics.name: tier0_accessor
heuristics.description: Accessor and binder annotations are implementation details
heuristics.rule: A property accessor, serialization accessor or web-data binder hook is below element granularity

heuristics.name: tier0_spring_component
heuristics.description: Spring component stereotypes mark application components
heuristics.rule: A class annotated @Component or @SpringBootApplication is a deployable application component

heuristics.name: tier0_spring_service
heuristics.description: Spring service stereotype narrows to service or component
heuristics.rule: A class annotated @Service exposes application behaviour; it is the service or the component providing it

heuristics.name: tier0_test_annotation
heuristics.description: Test annotations narrow to the testing layer
heuristics.rule: A test, test fixture or test configuration belongs to the testing layer

heuristics.name: tier0_ui_library
heuristics.description: Shared UI library directories hold library components
heuristics.rule: A component in a shared UI library directory (components/ui, packages/*/ui, design-system) is a reusable library component or a single action trigger, not a placed view

heuristics.name: tier0_file_route
heuristics.description: File-based route modules are views or routes
heuristics.rule: A module in a file-based routing directory (routes/, pages/, app/) is reached by navigation: a view, a subview placed in a layout, or the route itself

heuristics.name: tier0_interface_default
heuristics.description: Other interfaces are application data objects or contracts
heuristics.rule: Any interface-like symbol no earlier rule decided is an in-code data structure or contract: an application data object, application interface or application event (published schemas are data-model, but an in-code interface is not a published schema; design charter, 2026-10-25 relabelling); the classifier chooses, or says none

inference_rules.name: function-promotion-to-service
inference_rules.description: Qualified functions can be promoted to services via heuristic signals
inference_rules.pattern: applicationfunction + (min_fan_in >= 5 OR directory_match OR naming_patterns OR is_entry_point) => applicationservice

inference_rules.name: verify_scope_v1
inference_rules.description: Scope boundary rule: verify_role=primary applies only to api.operation (Route elements) in v1
inference_rules.pattern: verify_role: primary => api.operation only (excludes Function, Method, Class, Module)

filtering_rules.name: confidence_floor
filtering_rules.description: Filter mappings below confidence threshold to reduce noise

filtering_rules.name: test_code_exclusion
filtering_rules.description: Exclude test files and test-related code from mapping

deduplication_rules.name: semantic-duplicate-detection
deduplication_rules.description: Detect and merge semantically equivalent mappings
